parameters.query: SELECT t.source, v.category_id, extract(hour from v.published_at) AS publish_hour, avg(a.views) AS avg_views, avg(a.ctr) AS avg_ctr, avg(a.watch_time_minutes) AS avg_watch_time FROM analytics_daily a JOIN videos v ON v.id = a.video_id AND a.is_short = false JOIN topics t ON t.id = v.topic_id WHERE a.metric_date >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY t.source, v.category_id, publish_hour
